spookyhash_v2_128.impl: let mut h = val; h ^= aux; h = h.rotate_left(15); h = h.wrapping_add(aux); h

siphash_2_4_branchless.impl: let mut v0 = val; let mut v1 = aux; v0 = v0.wrapping_add(v1); v1 = v1.rotate_left(13); v1 ^= v0; v0

highwayhash_64.impl: let mut a = u; let mut b = v; a = a.wrapping_add(b); b = b.rotate_left(31); a = a.wrapping_mul(0xd6e8feb86659fd93); a ^= a >> 32; a

clhash.impl: let h = val ^ aux; let h = h.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15); h ^ (h >> 33)
clhash.ref: let h = val ^ aux; let h = h.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15); h ^ (h >> 33)

minhash_u64_k.ref: let h = val.wrapping_mul(0x9E3779B97F4A7C15); if h < aux { h } else { aux }

hyperloglog_add_u64.impl: let r = (val.wrapping_shr(aux as u32)).leading_zeros() + 1; r as u64
hyperloglog_add_u64.ref: let r = (val.wrapping_shr(aux as u32)).leading_zeros() + 1; r as u64

hyperloglog_merge.ref: if val > aux { val } else { aux }

count_min_sketch_query.impl: let c1 = val & 0xFFFF; let c2 = (val >> 16) & 0xFFFF; let c3 = (val >> 32) & 0xFFFF; let c4 = (val >> 48) & 0xFFFF; (c1.min(c2)).min(c3.min(c4))
count_min_sketch_query.ref: let c1 = val & 0xFFFF; let c2 = (val >> 16) & 0xFFFF; let c3 = (val >> 32) & 0xFFFF; let c4 = (val >> 48) & 0xFFFF; (c1.min(c2)).min(c3.min(c4))

bloom_filter_query_u64.ref: let h = aux.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15); let mask = (1u64 << (h & 63)) | (1u64 << ((h >> 8) & 63)) | (1u64 << ((h >> 16) & 63)); if (val & mask) == mask { 1 } else { 0 }

quotient_filter_add_u64.impl: let q = val >> 32; let r = val & 0xFFFFFFFF; (q ^ r).wrapping_add(aux)
quotient_filter_add_u64.ref: let q = val >> 32; let r = val & 0xFFFFFFFF; (q ^ r).wrapping_add(aux)

reservoir_sample_branchless.impl: let keep = (aux < val) as u64; keep
